entry.title: PulyTek 1.0.2
entry.summary: Reduces display work by reading the two meter values directly instead of scanning 34 parameters per snapshot. Audio binary identical to the CPU-tested build; version metadata now uses 1.0.2 without a preview suffix. Local before/after audio comparison was bit-identical. Installation and application restart checked on Force 3.9.1; full firmware 3.10 and MPC hardware validation remain pending. entry.title: PulyTek 1.0.1
entry.summary: PulyTek is a separate open-source Pultec-style EQ port for the native Akai Force/MPC Gen1 OpenPlugin format. - Blue vintage panel, Bakelite-style knobs, ribbed selector buttons, warm lamps and stereo VU meters. - Upstream EQP-WDF-1A passive WDF circuit by Alberto Barrera / ABSounds, GPLv3. - Extra tube-colour switch with DRIVE, WARMTH and continuous wet/dry MIX, six-frequency AIR shelf with one continuous AMOUNT control, output trim and full bypass. - Side Mixing on/off, 0–200% stereo width, sid
